subject: Appended two bullets to UNRELEASED.md, which your claim covers (additive, your claim untouched)
body:
Heads-up, not a request. MPI-633 (gallery renditions) appended two bullets to the
## Fixes section of docs/releases/UNRELEASED.md, which your claim record 77c21420
covers. Purely additive - two new bullets at the end of the section, no edit to any
existing entry and no change to the Flows roster, so a merge should be clean.

The two entries: "Big gallery cards are sharp" (the image rendition ladder) and
"Hovering a video card costs a fraction of what it did" (the 720p hover proxy).

Why it went in without asking: your session ee477fd6 was last seen 2026-08-27 and is
well past the 120-minute heartbeat timeout, so there was no live writer to coordinate
with, and MPI-633 owed those entries as a released-behaviour change. Your claim was NOT
released - MPI-596 is still in doing and the record is left exactly as it was.

One thing worth knowing if Object Stamp touches gallery cards: a sidecar can now carry
thumbPathLg (image, only when the source is wider than 1280) and proxyPath (video, only
when the clip is taller than 720p). Both are optional and absent means "the original is
that tier", not "missing". docs/gallery.md and docs/project-integrity.md have the
contract.
